scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @devdock/contracts && npm run build -w @devdock/platform && npm run build -w @devdock/storage && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @devdock/web
scripts.lint: biome check bin apps/daemon/src apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts packages/contracts/src packages/platform/src packages/storage/src scripts tests package.json biome.json tsconfig.json apps/daemon/package.json apps/daemon/tsconfig.json apps/web/package.json apps/web/tsconfig.json packages/contracts/package.json packages/platform/package.json packages/storage/package.json packages/contracts/tsconfig.json packages/platform/tsconfig.json packages/storage/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs integration
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs browser
scripts.verify:package: npm run check:versions && npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/package-install.test.mjs
scripts.verify:release: npm run check:toolchain && npm run check:versions && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:browser && npm run verify:clean-setup && npm run package:local
scripts.build: npm run build -w @devdock/contracts && npm run build -w @devdock/platform && npm run build -w @devdock/storage && npm run build -w @devdock/web && npm run build -w @devdock/daemon
scripts.package:local: npm run check:versions && npm run build && npm pack --pack-destination artifacts
